            Built-in Hero music: “Wave Rider” by Shane Ivers – silvermansound.com (CC BY 4.0)

            💰 Gross

            Gross = front + back on this month's deals. When you log a deal, a mini gets Kunle's “Is it profitable?” stamp and a deal at or above the stamp amount gets “PROFITABLE ✓”.

            🔴 App icon badge

            Shows a red number on the Trip Pad icon for customer follow-ups due and pending deals that need a follow-up.

            📕 Close the book

            Done for the month? Close the book to lock the Fun Trip Pad until next month.

            📱 Lock screen card

            Makes a picture of this month's numbers you can save and set as your lock screen.
